5095393383453.sourceDescription:
This artificial Christmas tree features a distinctive snowy pencil design with white-covered branches that create a beautiful winter aesthetic. The slim profile ensures it fits perfectly in smaller spaces without compromising on festive charm.

The construction utilizes tough flame retardant plastic material which enhances safety during use around naked flames and lights. This durable build quality allows the tree to be reused year after year without losing its structural integrity or visual appeal.

A sturdy metal base is included to keep the six-foot tree standing steady and balanced throughout the festive season. This robust support system prevents tipping and ensures the tree remains upright even when decorated with ornaments. The stable foundation provides confidence when hanging decorations on the upper branches safely.

Setting up this narrow Christmas tree is simple as you just need to fit the sections together and fix the branches into place. The assembly process is straightforward, requiring minimal effort to achieve a fully formed decorative piece. This ease of setup makes it ideal for those who prefer quick and hassle-free holiday preparations.

The dimensions of the assembled tree are 180cm in height with a diameter of 52cm, making it suitable for corners or tight areas. Weighing approximately 3.3kg, it is lightweight yet substantial enough to hold its shape well. This compact size allows for flexible placement options within various room layouts while providing ample space for decorations.
Slim pencil design fits perfectly in small apartments and tight spaces.
Snowy white branches create a beautiful winter aesthetic for festive decor.
Sturdy metal base included to keep the tree steady and balanced.
Easy assembly with simple section fitting and branch placement.
Guarantee - 1 month
Artificial christmas tree type: Hooked
Assembly required
With stand

5056095713153.variantName: True Products 6ft Pre-Lit Fraser Fir Artificial Christmas Tree - Warm White Lights
5056095713153.sourceDescription:
Bring a welcoming glow to your home with our Pre-Lit Fraser Fir Christmas Tree. Combining realistic foliage with warm white LED lights, creates a timeless festive centrepiece for cosy evenings and Christmas celebrations.

This Fraser Fir has a traditional silhouette that suits everything from delicate neutral decorations to rich reds and golds. Its mixed tips combine realistic PE foliage with PVC tips to create a full, natural-looking backdrop for your favourite ornaments.

The lights are already fitted, leaving you free to enjoy decorating. Settle on a steady glow for a relaxed atmosphere, add a little twinkle or choose a gentle slow fade. With 8 multifunction settings, you can change the effect to suit the occasion. The lighting is mains powered through a low voltage transformer.

Hinged branches fold down for assembly, and the included folding metal stand provides a practical base. Gently spread the branches and arrange each tip to bring out the tree's full shape, then finish with treasured baubles and your chosen tree topper.

Features:
 Light functions: 8 settings, including steady glow, twinkle and slow fade
 Power supply: Mains powered with a low voltage transformer
 Realistic mixed PE and PVC foliage
 Traditional Christmas tree shape
 Hinged branch construction
 Folding metal stand included
 For indoor use only

Take time to separate and shape the branches after assembly to achieve a full, balanced appearance.
Height: 6ft / 1.8m
Diameter: 114cm
Tip count: 847 (272 PE and 575 PVC)
Lights: 350 warm white LEDs
Guarantee - 1 year
Tool free assembly
With stand

Each Christmas tree features 140 branch tips to create a decorative artificial evergreen appearance and can be arranged by adjusting the branches to suit your display. Each tree is presented in a decorative pot, providing a freestanding design that can be incorporated easily into your existing Christmas decorations. Suitable for seasonal displays in homes, offices and shops, this 2 pack provides a simple way to create an attractive illuminated Christmas arrangement.

5037204458653.variantName: Christmas Baubles - Festive Tree Ornaments - Snowflake Detail and Hanging Cord - Wood - Designed for Christmas at Home - 8 Pack
5037204458653.sourceDescription:
Christmas Baubles
Add colour and detail to your Christmas tree with these decorative baubles. Their hanging format lets you spread the ornaments through the branches or combine them with other suitable festive displays for a coordinated seasonal arrangement.

Snowflake Detail
Snowflake detailing adds a winter themed accent to the design. The pattern can be used alongside simpler decorations to vary the visual texture of a seasonal arrangement while keeping the display within a coordinated festive theme.

Hanging Cord
The hanging cord gives the ornament a defined attachment point for a suitable support. It allows the decorative face to remain visible and makes it easy to include the piece among other hanging accents in the intended display.

Lightweight Design
The lightweight form is convenient to handle and move between suitable locations. It also makes the item easier to include when organising a bag or storage space.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Product details
Material: Wood. Quantity: 8 pack.
Decorative wooden baubles featuring intricate snowflake detailing for a festive winter theme.
Includes hanging cords for easy attachment to Christmas tree branches or other displays.
Lightweight design ensures convenient handling and effortless storage when not in use.
Set of eight ornaments allows you to create a coordinated and colourful seasonal arrangement.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Resistant to shattering
Included: Hanging Cord
Hanger included

6313817035153.baseName: 60CM Black Birch Tree Light, Warm White LED Tabletop Bonsai Tree Lamp, Battery USB Powered, Artificial Tree Light
6313817035153.variantName: 60CM Black Birch Tree Light, Warm White LED Tabletop Bonsai Tree Lamp, Battery USB Powered, Artificial Tree Light
6313817035153.sourceDescription:
Product Features:

 60cm birch tree lamp, available in two colors: black birch, white birch, with warm white LED lamp beads. Dual power supply options: battery power / USB power supply. Indoor placement is not limited by sockets.
 It can be bent to form branches, allowing for free adjustment of the tree shape to create the desired look. The square stable base has an anti-toppling design, and the overall design is lightweight, making it convenient to move.
 Low-voltage LED light source, soft and non-glaring light, safe for long-term illumination. Suitable for Christmas, Thanksgiving, New Year, parties, and daily home atmosphere decoration.
 Easy to assemble, boxed packaging for easy storage, also suitable as a gift. Suitable for bedroom, living room, shelves, fireplaces, entrance tables for decoration.


Product Specifications:

 Quantity: 1 piece
 Color: White / Black
 Material: Plastic
 Size: 60cm


Packaging Contents:
Christmas decorative lights * 1

Note:

 This tree lamp is only for indoor use. It is not waterproof and should not be exposed to rain or placed in a damp environment.
 The battery-powered version does not come with a battery and needs to be purchased separately.
 When not in use for a long time, please unplug the USB power supply or remove the battery.
 Only wipe the surface with a soft dry cloth. Do not wash or soak it.
 There may be slight color differences on the screens of different devices, which is a normal phenomenon.
 Please confirm the style, size and color before placing an order.
This 60cm birch tree light is available in black birch and white birch versions with warm white LEDs. It adopts dual power supply design, supporting both battery and USB power, flexible for different indoor placement scenes. The delicate branches can be bent freely to adjust the shape you like.
Soft warm white lighting creates a cozy and relaxing atmosphere. This tabletop bonsai tree lamp is perfect for bedroom, living room, dining table, shelf, fireplace and entryway decoration. It is an ideal holiday decor for Christmas, Thanksgiving, New Year and daily home ornament.
Safe low voltage LED lights, no overheating after long-time lighting. The artificial tree is lightweight and comes with a stable base, it will not tip over easily. Packaged in box, easy to store when not in use.
Easy to assemble and install. Just tighten the trunk and base, spread out the branches, then power on to light up. No complicated wiring required, you can place it anywhere you want conveniently.
Great gift choice for family, friends and decor lovers. This lighted birch tree is a wonderful table decoration, also works as a nice photo backdrop prop for holiday parties and family gatherings.

Safe & Premium Craft Materials: Built from solid acrylic panels, gentle artificial cotton and long-lasting low-voltage LED light string. The supplied 3M back adhesive delivers reliable adhesion on flat walls. This decor is made exclusively for indoor use.

 Different from ordinary USB string lights, this version comes with a professional 5V/3A 15W UK standard power adapter for stable and continuous power supply, ensuring brighter lighting and longer service life without voltage instability.

 Total Length: 1.8 Meters
 LED Quantity: 400 High-Bright RGB LED Beads
 Power Supply: Professional 5V/3A 15W UK Plug Power Adapter

5056903233453.variantName: 1.8m Glitter Ficus Leaves Garland White 12 Pieces Christmas Tree Garland Glitter Foliage Mantel Stair
5056903233453.sourceDescription:
Bring white foliage into your seasonal decorating with this pack of 12 artificial ficus garlands, each measuring 1.8m. Pointed leaf shapes branch along the garland, bringing an open leafy outline and a glittered surface to festive arrangements. The glitter finish adds a decorative accent to Christmas displays, while the white colour helps coordinate the arrangement with your chosen ribbons and ornaments. Lay a length along a mantel, arrange it around a banister or incorporate it into a festive window display. The artificial leaves can also form part of Christmas table centrepieces, wreath-making projects and indoor wedding decorations, allowing the same foliage style to appear in different areas. Plan each length around the space available and position your own accessories alongside it to complete the look. This option contains 12 separate garlands, allowing you to repeat the design across several locations or arrange individual lengths alongside one another. Combine the glittered foliage with plain decorations for contrasting texture, or use it within a wider festive colour theme for your home or party setting.
Glitter Ficus Garland: Includes 12 matching white artificial ficus leaf garlands, each measuring 1.8m. The glitter finish adds colour and texture to Christmas tree decorations, mantel arrangements and festive table displays, with decorative foliage spaced along the length for a leafy seasonal accent.
Decorative Leaf Design: Pointed leaf shapes branch along the garland, bringing an open leafy outline and a glittered surface to festive arrangements. The white colour can be used as the main accent or combined with other seasonal decorations, adding a leafy detail to indoor Christmas and party displays.
Mantel And Stair Decor: Arrange the 1.8m foliage length along a mantel, position it around a banister or use it within a Christmas window display. Plan the layout to suit your space, then add your own ribbons and ornaments to coordinate the garland with nearby festive decorations.
Table And Wreath Arrangements: Incorporate the white ficus foliage into Christmas table centrepieces, decorative wreath projects or indoor wedding displays. The glittered leaves provide a repeated accent that can link place settings, mantel greenery and other seasonal arrangements.
Pack Size And Coverage: Contains 12 separate garlands, each with a 1.8m decorative length. Arrange the individual lengths across separate areas or alongside one another. Coordinate with your own ribbons and ornaments to carry the foliage theme through your indoor seasonal arrangement.

5056589155353.sourceDescription:
Bring a timeless finishing touch to your Christmas tree with this beautifully detailed Christmas Angel tree topper. A charming traditional Christmas decoration that can be brought out and enjoyed year after year.

Designed to sit proudly at the very top of your tree, the angel is dressed in an elegant gold detailed dress complemented by a traditional red coat finished with white fur trim. The decorative detailing give her a classic festive appearance that works beautifully with both traditional and contemporary Christmas displays.

Measuring approximately 30cm tall, this Christmas tree topper creates an eye-catching focal point without overwhelming the rest of your tree decorations. Pair with baubles, ribbons, garlands and lights to complete your seasonal display.

Suitable for indoor use only.

BEAUTIFULLY DETAILED DESIGN – The angel features carefully considered decorative details that create an elegant focal point amongst your Christmas lights, baubles, ribbons and garlands.
CLASSIC FESTIVE OUTFIT – Dressed in a detailed gold dress with a traditional red coat and contrasting white fur trim for a warm and recognisable Christmas look.
CHRISTMAS TREE TOPPER – Measuring approximately 30cm high, 20cm long and 12cm wide, this decorative Christmas Angel is designed to complete the top of your tree.
INDOOR CHRISTMAS DECORATION – A charming traditional Christmas decoration for decorating Christmas trees throughout the festive season. For indoor use only.

8884419681553.variantName: 10m USB LED star string lights, ideal for bedrooms, parties, weddings and Christmas
8884419681553.sourceDescription: 10m LED Starry String Lights: This 10m long LED string light is adorned with 100 adorable little stars. Each star measures 3.3cm, not too big and not too small. These star-shaped string lights are made of sturdy crystal PVC and emit a soft, warm glow. The clear white wires beautifully complement the stars. Each LED star is spaced 15cm apart. Battery/USB Powered String Lights: This string light is powered by 3 AA batteries (not included). Its total power is 4.5V, low voltage, safe and contactless, ideal for families with children. The upgraded LEDs are energy-efficient, long-lasting, and provide high, consistent brightness. It's a safe decorative night light for children's bedrooms, girls' rooms, princess play tents, dorm rooms, and bed frames. 2-Mode String Lights: Flashing or Steady On. Compared to plug-in string lights, these firefly string lights require no additional wires or plugs, making them more portable and easier to install wherever you like. The optional on/off switch on the battery compartment makes them easy to use. This bohemian-style hanging decoration can be used on tapestries, tents, ceilings, awnings, curtains, walls, garlands, and wreaths. [Long-lasting, durable fantasy light] The IP65 waterproof copper wire prevents overheating and is energy-efficient. The clear PVC sheath provides flexibility and protects the copper wire from breakage. The battery compartment is not waterproof. Store indoors, away from water. This miniature string of lights is suitable for indoor and outdoor use in living rooms, offices, kitchens, verandas, balconies, patios, gazebos, caravans, terraces, awnings, and camping. [Warm White Christmas Lights] Hang this starry string of lights for the holidays or an upcoming event. Its soft, warm white light creates a cozy and romantic atmosphere. This versatile mini string of lights is suitable for Christmas, New Year's, Ramadan, Halloween, birthdays, Valentine's Day, and many other occasions.

5390711606253.sourceDescription:
Bring a touch of authentic Irish charm to your festive decor with this official Guinness Pint Glass Christmas Tree Ornament.

Featuring the iconic Guinness pint glass design, this charming ornament adds a little authentic Irish charm to any Christmas tree!

Crafted from lightweight glass with a premium glossy shine, it reflects festive fairy lights beautifully and hangs effortlessly on trees big or small, real or artificial.

Completed with a rich red hanging ribbon branded with the classic Guinness logo, it provides a secure fit on branches while adding an extra pop of traditional colour to your festive setup.
Official Guinness Christmas Tree Ornament - Bring distinctive Irish character to your festive decorations with this Guinness Pint Glass ornament, recreating the iconic stout-filled pint as a charming addition to your Christmas tree.

5096042275853.variantName: LED Christmas wreath - Light-up door wreath - Welcome hanger and 20 warm white LEDs for doors and walls - Green and white, 45 cm
5096042275853.sourceDescription:
A 35 cm cast-iron hanger bearing a welcome greeting accompanies the snowy wreath. Twenty warm white LEDs shine through the branches, making both the greeting and the frosted finish part of the doorway display. At 45 cm across, it is easy to measure out the space it will occupy before choosing a position.

The lighting gives this wreath two different uses in the same spot. In natural daylight the decorative details provide the colour and texture. Once the lights are switched on, the outline is still visible from the far end of a hall. The pale tips give the arrangement its own highlights in daylight. Against dark paint the snowy edge is easy to follow, while a lighter background draws attention to the darker details tucked further into the design.

Allow access to the battery compartment when arranging the display. Positioning it where you can change the cells without disturbing the front of the decoration makes a difference if you leave it up throughout the season. Warm white light works well alongside wood, brass and cream finishes. If you already have lighting in the same part of the room, see how the two colours look together at dusk before choosing the final position.

A plain background lets you see the smaller details even from the other side of the room. Try holding the wreath against a light wall and then against a darker door before fixing the hanging point. If you are using other Christmas lighting nearby, try the wreath on its own first. A little distance between the light sources helps each point remain visible and lets the pattern around the wreath read clearly.

A darker backdrop makes the outline of a lit wreath stand out from across the room. Against a pale wall the same light gives a softer effect, particularly alongside plain decorations that leave some wall space visible.
Features a charming welcome hanger and 20 warm white LEDs for festive illumination.
Designed with snow-effect branches and a frosted finish for a realistic winter look.
Includes a sturdy 35 cm cast-iron hanger for secure and easy wall or door mounting.
Battery powered operation allows flexible placement without the need for nearby sockets.
Comes with Welcome hanger
Fittings & fixings included

Welcome the festive season with this beautiful, traditional pinecone wreath. Ready to hang, this decoration provides an instant touch of Christmas warmth to any space. It serves as a perfect centrepiece for a door or as a charming addition to your indoor wall décor.
This wreath is built on a sturdy base, intricately woven with natural pinecones and festive embellishments. Each design offers a unique combination of elements, from frosted berries and bright apples to elegant silver and gold accents. The wreath includes a strong jute loop, making it simple to hang securely on any standard hook or nail right out of the box. Its durable construction ensures it can be stored and reused for many holiday seasons to come.

Imagine this wreath greeting your guests as they arrive, setting a warm and inviting tone for your home during the holidays. Whether it’s hanging proudly on your front door, adding festive cheer above a fireplace, or bringing seasonal colour to your hallway, it effortlessly complements your existing Christmas decorations. It’s a timeless piece that brings the classic look of a winter forest into your home.
